units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Rouge, there you are! We have a lot to say to you!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: We’ve visited every train car so far, and everyone’s said they’ve seen you wandering about.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: It’s high time you told us why!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: My my, talk about a warm welcome. Quick to the point, aren’t you darling?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: And I see you’ve brought the microwave master with you?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… please don’t let that be my legacy…)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: Tails is right, folks have brought you up a lot. Care to explain?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: …Tell ‘em, Rouge. We’re gonna need the help.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Blaze…?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Alright. I’ve been hunting for a treasure rumored to be stored here on the train.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(T-treasure?? They certainly didn’t tell me about treasure in the interview.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Since I’m part business tycoon, part purveyor of fine collectibles, I knew I had to find it.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: Tell ‘em what it is, Rouge.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Alright. Well…
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: It’s a <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Wow, that does sound extravagant.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: But please don’t tell me you accepted Amy’s birthday invite only to find that egg…
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: A woman can have multiple goals! I gave Amy her <style=Important>birthday present</style> already, so everything’s well taken care of.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: She roped me in on the hunt immediately. I stayed here while she searched the train cars for clues.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: I deduced that the <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style> is here, in this train car, locked in a safe.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Wait, so the treasure is real?? It’s actually here?)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: And what did you manage to find, Rouge?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Oh, well why don’t you both take a look.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: I found the train’s blueprints in the <style=CarName>library car</style>, with the safe code written right on it! The score of a lifetime!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: The train’s blueprints…? Please Rouge, let us see that!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Uh uh uh, finder’s keepers, sweetheart.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: There’s a problem. We need your assistance.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: What kind of problem?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: The elevator behind the security guard leads us right to the room holding the <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style>.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: But we’re not getting anywhere without the guard’s access card.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: We need a plan to get that card to use the elevator. And our chance of success grows with everyone’s help.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: So… you want us to help you steal the <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style>?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Blaze? You don’t have a problem with this?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: …I see no issues here. Sounds like a fine business venture.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… her lore card must be influencing her decisions here.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Either that, or breaking the rules must be refreshing for a princess.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: ? Do you have an opinion on this?
Stealing is for squares.
It’s time for a five finger discount!

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: I think the only square here is you, microwave master.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: I must admit, that wasn’t the coolest thing I’ve heard someone say.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(N-no! My cool and mysterious reputation! It’s crumbling!)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: Alright alright, I’m in. I’ll help.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Well… I suppose if both Blaze and
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: are in…

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Ok! Let’s get that <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style>!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Heheh, that’s the ticket! Happy to have you both on the team.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Now, we must plan.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Oh boy… what have we gotten ourselves into…)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Access to the <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style> room is behind a locked elevator door. The security guard has the access card. Do we:
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Attack the guard
Bribe the guard
Distract the guard

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: I can’t say I’m comfortable attacking a Chao.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Let’s keep violence to a minimum, shall we?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Less fun, but I agree. Let’s think about it again.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: Anyone have anything we can use for a bribe?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: I have a pair of tweezers.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Oh, here’s a trading card!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: I’m not giving you anything.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Maybe bribing isn’t the way to go…)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Distract them, perfect! We’re all charming enough for that to work.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: , is everything ok? I’ve never seen you smile like that.

units.speaker: Barry

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Ok, who’s distracting the security guard?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Rouge
Tails
Blaze

units.sourceText: Of course I’ll distract them! Who could resist my… feminine charms.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: I’m not sure how effective your ‘charms’ will be on a Chao…
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: Plus, your flight might prove useful. I’m not sure you being the distraction makes sense.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Oh well, fair enough! Let’s think it over again.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: S-sure! I, I could be the distraction.

units.sourceText: I don’t like the way he said that. Veto.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: I’m with Blaze, his delivery was shaky.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: Think you could distract the guard, Blaze?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: In my life I’ve never let a single person down. I won’t falter.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: G-great. <style=Thought>(Her voice was so stoic. I have chills.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Well, I trust her. Moving on…
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: What’s the distraction?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Pretend the claw machine is stuck
Push a bunch of poker chips to the floor
Ask the Chao about their partner and kids

units.speaker: Barry

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: This’ll work great as a distraction. Let’s continue the plan.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Causing a ruckus, I like it a lot.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: That’ll get the guard’s attention for sure! Let’s move forward.

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Perfect! I think we can move on, then.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: With the guard distracted, Rouge, how will you get the access card?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Grab them and fly up to the rafters
Ask for the card
Pick their pocket

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: I dunno, I don’t want any violence!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: There won’t be any violence. I’ll just tie them up to a rafter, easy.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Where do we get the rope??
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: …Interesting point, maybe we should try something else.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: No harm in asking, right?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: Oh you naive, innocent soul.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Such a fresh face, this one. So cute.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Do you suggest we take the guard out shoe shopping next?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: I don’t think Chao wear shoes… <style=Thought>(These ladies are ruthless! I better rethink this.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: Excellent, we can count on you Rouge!

units.sourceText: Try not to take anything else from them, if you can help it.

units.sourceText: , what’s your plan?
Say there's a drink without a coaster
Push the security guard over

units.sourceText: Absolutely vile. I can think of nothing worse.

units.sourceText: Despicable. I would never allow such a thing in my kingdom.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Blaze
units.sourceText: The guard will go running immediately, I’m sure of it.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Great, and with the guard distracted, we’ll all head to the elevator.

units.sourceText: I’m still not comfortable with any violence here…

units.sourceText: But if they start crying, it'd bring unwanted attention to us.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Decent point. Let's think of something else.

units.sourceText: …then you’d be marrying into the royal family. What is your heritage?

units.sourceText: Any war crimes I should know about?

units.sourceText: What? Well I, um- -

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: Uh you know what, maybe we should try something else.

units.sourceText: Interesting, you give up far too easily as well. We’d have to work on your fortitude.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: I said we’ll try something else!

Pop some apple cider
Sing victory acapella

units.sourceText: My high fives aren’t given away willy-nilly. They are to be cherished.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: I don’t think my hands would survive a high five from them… let’s rethink this.

units.speaker: Barry

units.sourceText: Um, I can, but I gotta sing a little song while I do it.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Tails
units.sourceText: I’m gonna step in here and veto this, let’s think of something else.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: Guess someone didn’t want to hear my song.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Oh no, Tails is taking a while and the arms are tightening their grip!

units.sourceText: Cry and hope they sympathize
Imagine you’re not in pain

units.speaker: Barry

units.speaker: Rouge
units.sourceText: Darlings, I’m happy to say, this plan is perfect.

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Now, Rouge…
